questions.question: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan is a flagship programme of the government of India, that was started in 2001 to achieve ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Universalisation of Elementary Education (UEE)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) is the Government of India's flagship program for achieving Universalisation of Elementary Education (UEE).
 
• Launched in 2001, SSA aims to provide free and compulsory education to children aged 6-14 years.
 
• The program focuses on bridging gender and social gaps in education.
 
• SSA is aligned with the mandate of the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009, which makes education a fundamental right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009:**

 
 
• Ensures free and compulsory education for children aged 6-14 years in India.
 
• Mandates 25% reservation for disadvantaged sections in private schools.
 
• Sets norms and standards for pupil-teacher ratios, infrastructure, and teacher qualifications.
 
 
 
• **Mid-Day Meal Scheme:**
 
 
• Provides free lunches on working days for children in primary and upper primary classes.
 
• Aims to improve nutritional status of children and encourage school attendance.
 
 
 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**
 
 
• Aims to overhaul the Indian education system and improve the quality of education.
 
• Focuses on early childhood care and education, foundational literacy, and numeracy.
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA):**
 
 
• Launched in 2009 to enhance access to secondary education and improve its quality.
 
• Aims to achieve a gross enrollment ratio of 100% in secondary education by 2030.

questions.question: In October 2021, the Ministry of Civil Aviation launched a scheme which will integrate cargo-related infrastructure in airports of hilly, tribal, and north-east regions. Name the scheme launched by the Ministry of Civil Aviation.

The correct answer is** Krishi Udan 2.0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​​Krishi Udan 2.0 was announced on 27 October 2021** enhancing the existing provisions, mainly focusing on transporting perishable food products from the hilly areas, Northi-Eastern States and tribal areas.
 
• Union Minister of Civil Aviation Jyotiraditya Scindia released Krishi UDAN 2.0.
 
• The scheme proposes to facilitate and incentivize the movement of Agri-produce by air transportation. 
 
• It lays out the vision of improving value realization through better integration and optimization of Agri-harvesting and air transportation.
 
• It works by contributing to Agri-value chain sustainability and resilience under different and dynamic conditions. 
 
• It will be implemented at 53 airports across the country mainly focusing on Northeast and tribal regions and is likely to benefit farmers, freight forwarders, and Airlines.
 
• Key highlights of the scheme
 
 
• Facilitating and incentivizing movement of Agri-produce by air transportation: Full waiver of Landing, Parking, TNLC, and RNFC charges for Indian freighters and P2C at selected Airports. Primarily, focusing on NER, Hilly, and tribal regions.
 
• Strengthening cargo-related infrastructure at airports and off airports: Facilitating the development of a hub and spoke model and a freight grid.
 
• Concessions sought from other bodies: Seek support and encourage States to reduce Sales Tax to 1% on aviation fuels for freighters / P2C aircraft as extended in UDAN flights.

• **The Swarna Jayanti Shahari Rojgar Yojana (SJSRY)** was launched in the year **1997**__ by the Government of India.
 
• SJSRY is aimed at providing gainful employment to the urban unemployed and underemployed poor by encouraging the setting up of self-employment ventures or provision of wage employment.
 
• The scheme focuses on providing skill development training to the urban poor to enhance their employability.
 
• It also includes support for the establishment of micro-enterprises by urban poor women and youth.
 
• The implementation of the scheme is done by urban local bodies (ULBs) with the support of state governments.

• The focus of the scheme was to provide sustainable livelihood opportunities through skill development and micro-enterprises, with a special emphasis on women and vulnerable sections of society.
 
• Under the scheme, urban local bodies were encouraged to form community structures such as self-help groups (SHGs) and community development societies (CDSs) to facilitate the implementation of the program.

questions.question: According to the National Population Policy 2000, what is the target year for reaching stability in population?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2045**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Population Policy 2000 was formulated by the Government of India to address the issues of population growth and reproductive health.
 
• The policy aims to achieve a stable population by the year 2045, consistent with the requirements of sustainable economic growth, social development, and environmental protection.
 
• The policy includes objectives such as the reduction of infant mortality rate and maternal mortality rate, and promotion of contraceptive methods.
 
• It emphasizes universal access to quality health care services, including family planning and reproductive health services.
 
• Educational programs and awareness campaigns are crucial components of the policy to ensure informed choices regarding family planning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Infant Mortality Rate (IMR)**

 
 
• IMR refers to the number of infant deaths (under one year) per 1,000 live births in a given year.
 
• Reducing the IMR is a key objective of the National Population Policy 2000.
 
 
 
• **Maternal Mortality Rate (MMR)**
 
 
• MMR refers to the number of maternal deaths per 100,000 live births due to complications from pregnancy or childbirth.
 
• The policy aims to bring down the MMR through improved healthcare services.
 
 
 
• **Contraceptive Methods**
 
 
• These include various methods and devices used to prevent pregnancy, ensuring family planning and reproductive health.
 
• The policy promotes the use of contraceptives to control population growth.
